notes.title: V2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Art Updates​
[olist]
All battle maps redesigned with terrain adjustments

Added hit-shake effects to combat animations

New grid overlay (adjust opacity in Settings)
[/olist]
​2. Gameplay Changes​
[olist]
Lightning strikes during storms no longer cause death

Post-Chapter 31 tournaments now grant Forging Scrolls (only for missed ones)

Growth System: Lock up to 2 attributes (guaranteed upgrade on level-up). Replaces Growth Amulets - now removed

Unequipped gear now sorts below currently equipped items

Manual saves now store deployment positions and unit selection

Support skill EXP now capped like tournaments (1st playthrough only)

Offensive skill damage increased. Skill slot cost set to 0

Map sprites now display correct facing direction

Hit calculation priority now exceeds Critical

Unit cap removed. Melee units +40 HP, Hybrid units +20 HP, Ranged units unchanged

Ranged weapons no longer benefit from Luck-based trait triggers

New Game+ added

6 new playable characters in New Game+

Optimized EN/JP translations
[/olist]
​3. Character & Equipment Adjustments​
[olist]
​Zhang Fei: New skill \[Three Armies' Valor]

Cannot follow-up: 33/66/100% chance to follow-up

Can follow-up: +10/20/30% follow-up damage

​Ma Chao: Reworked \[Death Pursuit]

SPD -3/6/9

33/66/100% chance to follow-up before enemy counter

​Guan Yu: \[God of War] armor break → Critical

​Guan Ping: New passive \[Immovable Mountain]

If not moved: +2/4/6 Insight & Detection until move/chapter end

​Lv Bu: \[Unrivaled General] no longer reduces MOV when using bows

​Zhou Cang: Trait changed from Iron Cavalry → Vanguard

​Wei Yan: Trait changed from Vanguard → Iron Cavalry

​New Class \[Shadow Guard]​: AGI+4, MOV+1

Lv10: EVA+20

Lv20: Counters ignore 100% DEF/Insight

​Archer Officer:

Lv10: HIT+20 → Lv20: HIT+20

​Mount Tai Soldier: "Reduce melee DMG" → "Reduce elemental DMG"

​Iron Cavalry Rework:
[/olist]
Per 3/3/2/2/1 MOV: DMG+1 & ignore 10% DEF/Insight (melee)

At max: Full armor break after 10+ MOV
[olist]
​Vanguard: DEF → HIT. Melee DMG taken -30%

​Cautious: Ranged DMG reduction lowered to 25%

​Green Dragon Blade: Armor break → Critical

​New Item \[Bamboo Talisman]​:
[/olist]
Full HP: Melee DMG+30% / Ranged DMG+15%
